name: WPC Backend Product Filter for WooCommerce
author: WPClever

sections.description:
Enhance your WooCommerce backend product management with the WPC Backend Product Filter plugin. This powerful tool provides administrators with the ability to filter products efficiently using any taxonomy, including custom taxonomies created by other plugins.

Key Features

  • Comprehensive Taxonomy Filtering:
  • Filter products by any taxonomy, including standard WooCommerce categories and tags, as well as custom taxonomies.

  • Enjoy seamless compatibility with taxonomies generated by third-party plugins.

  • Streamlined Product Management:

  • Quickly locate and manage specific products, saving valuable time and effort.

  • Improve your workflow by filtering products based on relevant criteria.

  • Enhanced Backend Functionality:

  • Gain greater control over your product inventory with advanced filtering options.
  • Simplify product organization and maintenance.

Benefits

  • Effortlessly manage large product catalogs.
  • Quickly identify and address product-related issues.
  • Improve overall backend efficiency.

Need more features?

  • WPC Variation Bulk Editor
  • WPC Variation Duplicator
  • WPC Smart Linked Products
  • WPC Custom Related Products
sections.installation:
1. Please make sure that you installed WooCommerce
  2. Go to plugins in your dashboard and select “Add New”
  3. Search for “WPC Backend Product Filter”, Install & Activate it
  4. Now you can go to WP-admin >> WPClever >> Backend Product Filter to configure
